summary: Read-only deep-read of the GDN conv1d prior-window M-dependence (how the deep-spine row conv1d_out depends on M/num_accepted under tree co-residency) + draft the bit-exact M-invariant alignment fix; adversarial verify the causal chain (would conv-fix reduce flips when QPAD/FA2-fix did not)

read.mechanism: In the tree-verify forward the deep-spine row's conv1d_out is computed in the conv_replacement block of scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py (the spec_sequence_masks branch replacing native causal_conv1d_update), FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED=True path. Per batch b and tree node i: (1) prior-window read = gather_committed_path_conv_prior_prepared(conv_state, bank_rows) at :1641-1646, bank_rows from prepare_committed_path_conv_rows at :1596-1610 (library gather_committed_path_conv_prior, fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:281-334) selecting per-b bank row = spec_state_indices[b, accepted_paths[b, num_accepted-1]] (accepted-leaf, node-indexed, pre-remap), prior_window = prior_bank[b].index_select(1, arange(width-1)) at :2197-2199; (2) per-node window = source.index_select(0, source_flat).view(tree_n,width,dim) at :2219-2221 = last width taps of (prior ++ committed-path tokens of node i), an M-invariant value-static gather; (3) acc = fused_tree_conv_taps_acc(window, conv_weights, bias) (fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:200-249): per-col tap=(x.bf16*w.bf16).bf16.f32, acc=bias.f32 + tap0 then +tap_c ascending in fp32; (4) out = triton_ex2_silu_bf16(acc) at :2510-2513. The inputs that vary with M: row-occupancy M (tree_n) does NOT vary the deep-spine arithmetic (per-b Python loop, no cross-row reduction in tap-acc or window gather) -> conv is row-occupancy M-invariant by construction, unlike the forked-FA2 kBlockM=64 query-tile. The num_accepted M (best_lcp) varies the bank/column prior selection (num_accepted-1), which is correct on HEAD; the only M-coupled OUTPUT divergence is the bf16-tap+silu MAC realization vs native's single fused causal_conv1d_update kernel (~1 bf16 ULP/layer; conv1d_out=9.77e-4 born from byte-exact pre_conv=0.0 at the deep-accept carrier; FR13_GATEA_DEEP_DIVERGENCE.md:65/79).
read.mDependenceSource: TWO M-dependences, distinguished. (1) num_accepted-driven prior bank/column selection in prepare_committed_path_conv_rows (fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:283-316) / gather_committed_path_conv_prior (fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:281-334): lens=num_accepted_tokens[:b]; read_col=accepted_paths[:b].gather(1, clamp(lens-1,...)); bank_row=spec_state_indices[:b].gather(1, read_col). This is the descendant of the 2026-06-09 conv1d_out=18.375 wrong-bank-row root, FIXED on HEAD (c0b53f5d/02b1627a/ef4d7514) and STALE -- live-confirmed correct because at the same deep-spine deep-accept flip event h0_state_in=0.0 (same bank row, FR13_GATEA_DEEP_DIVERGENCE.md:65; same num_accepted-1 convention across 4 touchpoints per FR13_NODE5_LADDER_DIFFUSE_BIND.md:44-46). (2) The SURVIVING carrier = bf16-tap MAC + silu realization in fused_tree_conv_taps_acc (fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:234-248) + _fr11_conv_tap_product (fr10_phase4...:2117-2129) + triton_ex2_silu_bf16, vs native _causal_conv1d_update_kernel (/tmp/vllm_live_019/.../ops/causal_conv1d.py:749+, spec-decode branch L859-861/L873 reads conv_state_token_offset=num_accepted-1 then its own fp32 MAC + ex2.approx silu + bf16 store). NOT row-layout/tiling, NOT a num_accepted gather error, NOT a replay-remap error.
read.convStateLayout: conv_state is the GDN conv cache [num_banks, dim, state_len] (state_len=conv_state.size(2); width-1=3 for width-4; live zero-pad state_len=12 > width-1=3). It is an as_strided VIEW over the SAME mamba page as the ssm cache (kv[0]=conv, kv[1]=ssm) with stride(0)==num_element_per_page (fr13_replay_conv_remap.py:7-18, fr10_phase4...:2096-2099) -- hence the page-safe torch remap. BANK (dim 0) = physical cache line addressed by spec_state_indices[b,col] (one bank per tree NODE column, kv-cache-group-local -> per-GROUP prep at :1571-1585); ROWS (dim 1) = dim feature channels; COLS (dim 2) = state_len conv taps, cols [0..width-2] = rolling prior taps, [width-1..state_len) = zero-pad. A committed-spine token reads its prior window from bank_row = spec_state_indices[b, accepted_paths[b, num_accepted-1]] (accepted-leaf bank, snapshotted PRE-remap), cols [0..width-2]; the per-node gather composes (prior ++ committed-path tokens) last-width taps. For a pure spine winner this is byte-identical to native's rolling-buffer read at column num_accepted-1 ([history2..historyM, draft1..draftN], prior_tokens at offset num_accepted-1, causal_conv1d.py:846-873) -- convention matches, only MAC realization differs.
read.numAcceptedRole: num_accepted_tokens (= committer best_lcp) enters twice. (a) Conv prior read: read_col=accepted_paths[b, num_accepted-1], bank_row=spec_state_indices[b, read_col] -- selects WHICH node's window is the prior (the genuine num_accepted M-dependence of the conv read; correct on HEAD). (b) Native reference (M=1 decode / MTP-5): conv_state_token_offset=num_accepted[idx_seq]-1 (causal_conv1d.py:859-861) selects the rolling-buffer prior column -- same num_accepted-1 convention. The project_fr13_conv_priorwindow_root num_accepted>1 wrong-row bug (bank 6 cols[0,1,2] vs native bank 1 cols[5,6,7] rolled tail, conv1d_out=18.375) is the 2026-06-09 finding -- FIXED + STALE on HEAD; do NOT re-chase. The current deep-accept (num_accepted>=3) M-signature is the bf16-tap realization, confirmed by h0_state_in=0.0 co-located with conv1d_out!=0 (the recurrent state used the SAME bank row, so the read is right; only the MAC differs).
read.priorWindowGather: gather_committed_path_conv_prior_prepared (fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:319-327) = per-layer index_select(conv_state,0,bank_rows): pure gather, M-INVARIANT given bank_rows (bank_rows is num_accepted-dependent but correct). replay_conv_state_linear_remap_prepared (fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:369-386) / replay_conv_state_linear_remap (fr13_replay_conv_remap.py:41-121) = gather-then-scatter (index_select materializes ALL source rows BEFORE any index_copy_ write) -> race-free in-place permutation (playbook class 3), conv-view logical elements only (page-safe), M-INVARIANT permutation. The prior-window SNAPSHOT is taken BEFORE this remap (:1527-1646), so the deep-spine prior read is unaffected by the remap regardless of M. So the gather + remap machinery is M-invariant; the only M-coupled input is the (correct) num_accepted-driven bank/column selection.
read.fixDraft: Replicate native causal_conv1d_update's EXACT conv op-sequence in our manual conv so the spine conv1d_out == M=1 decode conv1d_out bit-for-bit (NO reroute through causal_conv1d_update -- banned reward-hack). Two concrete edits, flag-gated FR13_CONV_EX2_REPLICA default-OFF: (1) src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_ex2_silu.py triton_ex2_silu_bf16 (consumed at fr10_phase4...:2511): make the silu an EXACT ex2.approx replica of native's hardware silu (exponent/fraction split + same polynomial + bf16 store rounding); (2) src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:234-248 fused_tree_conv_taps_acc: read native's width-4 column-accumulation order in causal_conv1d.py:874+ and align the `for col in range(start,width): acc = acc + prod_f32[:,col,:]` loop direction exactly (oldest..newest vs newest..oldest is load-bearing). Keep the bf16-tap arm (FR11-overturning fix; do NOT promote taps to fp32 -- fp32-taps regressed conv1d_out to 0.0625/input 0.3125). Uniform (spine+branch), not a path0 special-case, since the MAC/silu are per-element. Gate: ONE spine-only capture of pre_conv+conv_state+conv_weights+bias for clean-input layers L0,L4,L8,L12,L24,L36,L44 (pre_conv==0.0), iterate OFFLINE vs native on identical inputs until conv1d_out==0.0 RAW (NOT atol) for EVERY clean layer; then ONE live full-ladder = spine+branches+logits + e2e per-token argmax-vs-clean flip count (does cat9 22 -> ~native 3?). Decisive gate = e2e flip count, not per-layer 0.0.
read.fixRisks: Lossless: the fix moves spine conv1d_out CLOSER to native MTP-5/E5 (the lossless reference), so it cannot worsen spine losslessness. Risk = a WRONG silu replica regresses L0 (the fp32-taps variant did: conv1d_out 0.0625 + input_hidden 0.3125 global, FR13_GATEA_DEEP_DIVERGENCE.md:80) -- mitigated by the offline multi-clean-layer gate that catches the L0 regression before any boot. Speed: the silu replica is the SAME triton_ex2_silu_bf16 launch (shared lines, no extra device nodes); the MAC reorder is free (Python loop over width<=4). GB10 decode is weight-bandwidth-bound (~27 GB/forward) and the conv MAC is <1% of the forward, so a bit-exact realization is free on the bandwidth floor. Default-OFF-safe + replay-compatible: gate behind FR13_CONV_EX2_REPLICA default OFF (OFF arm = current silu verbatim = the A/B instrument); FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED/REPLAY_ROUTE/CONV_COMMITTED_PATH untouched (fix is inside tap-acc/silu, downstream of the snapshot+remap), so replay compatibility holds by construction. Re-arm the byte A/B (tests/test_fr13_tree_conv_fused_byte_ab.py) for the new replica per playbook class 10 (shared-source != shared-SASS): pin int-view RAW==0.0 / SASS hash, NEVER atol (the atol=1e-3 scan-replay gate does not certify, FR13_BV_SPILL_VERDICT.md:22).
read.notes: EVIDENCE TENSION RESOLVED: the task premise (conv1d prime suspect) and the two most-recent dual-verified binds (FR13_NODE5_LADDER_DIFFUSE_BIND, reference_diffuse_gdn_accumulation_explained: 'bank state-feed correct by construction, carrier is the recurrent state-feed') are RECONCILED -- conv1d_out is the FIRST-NONZERO L0 sub-op (entry point, localizable, has a concrete bit-exact patch) but the L0->L63 GROWTH is dominated by the diffuse recurrent state-feed (live rank-1 tree-scan vs clean chunked-prefill) realization. So: fix conv (this doc) AND expect a residual = diffuse state-feed -> if perfect conv alignment does NOT collapse the e2e flips, route to tree-reshape (project_fr13_tree_reshape_unifying_lever), NOT a per-op patch. Per-layer 0.0 is a DEV check; the verdict instrument is e2e cat9-vs-E5 within-floor (per-depth-argmax + bag-TV<=0.0593 + accept/event>=native), bring that pass/fail to the user. Design doc written + committed: /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/FR13_CONV_FIX_DESIGN.md (HEAD b6c30b4b, pathspec commit, only that file, no sweep). Key files traced: scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py (conv block :1293-2522), src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_tree_conv_fused.py, fr13_replay_conv_remap.py, fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:281-334, /tmp/vllm_live_019/vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/ops/causal_conv1d.py:749+. Live data: output/fr13_node7_ladder/ladder_summary.json (L0 GDN first-nonzero 0.0078125), output/fr13_node5_ladder/per_layer_maxabs.json, FR13_GATEA_DEEP_DIVERGENCE.md:65 (substate ladder). verify.causalChainRedTeam:
VERDICT: a conv1d M-invariant fix would NOT, on its own, move the 22 e2e flips to ~native 3 — for a DIFFERENT and stronger reason than the QPAD/FA2 null, and the design doc already concedes this in Section 6/7c/10. The L0-origin anchoring is solid and DOES distinguish conv from FA2: NODE7-LADDER (output/fr13_node7_ladder/ladder_summary.json) puts first-nonzero at L0 linear_attention=0.0078 (2 bf16-ULP, cos 0.99996), first full_attn at L3=0.0041 — strictly downstream. So unlike QPAD (FA2 is L3+, structurally incapable of erasing an L0-born 2-ULP divergence; QPAD fixed L31->0.0 yet e2e stayed 24, FR13_FA2_CARRIER_OVERTURNED_BIND.md:16-31), conv1d IS at the L0 GDN birthplace and IS the first-nonzero sub-op (FR13_GATEA_DEEP_DIVERGENCE.md:65: input_hidden 0.0 -> pre_conv 0.0 -> conv1d_out 9.77e-4 FIRST NONZERO -> h0_state_in 0.0 same bank row). So a conv fix is NOT pre-doomed by the L0 argument the way FA2 is.

BUT the decisive failure mode: the conv silu/ex2 replica this fix proposes was ALREADY substantially landed and the carrier ALREADY MOVED OFF conv. FR13_GATEA_DEEP_DIVERGENCE.md:204 (dated 2026-06-08): 'at L8 input_hidden=pre_conv=conv1d_out=0.0 (ex2 conv replica is bit-exact at the conv level) ... The conv silu grind SUCCEEDED. The live L8 first-divergence is a DIFFERENT sub-op: h0_state_in (GDN recurrent scan state) = 0.0007.' And the two MOST-RECENT dual-verified binds (FR13_NODE5_LADDER_DIFFUSE_BIND.md:15,38-61 GPU-ladder holds=TRUE + CPU code-read, 2026-06-14; FR13_DIFFUSE_GDN_EXPLAINED.md) independently conclude the surviving carrier is the DIFFUSE recurrent state-feed (live rank-1 tree-scan over the accepted chain [0,1,3,5] vs clean 1687-token chunked-prefill scan), born at L0, smoothly ratcheting to L63 (per_layer_maxabs 0/64 mismatch, no isolated spike), with the final-token argmax crystallizing at L60/L61 — NOT at conv, NOT at L0. NODE5 explicitly states 'There is no single-seam fix to chase here.'

WHY conv-alignment-doesn't-collapse-the-flips holds mechanically: the conv1d_out 9.77e-4 is the ENTRY POINT (first nonzero) but is ~1 bf16-ULP and small; the L0->L63 GROWTH that produces the flip is dominated by the recurrent scan state-feed realization, which is a SEPARATE op (h0_state_in/gdn_scan_out) and which the design doc itself (Section 6 caveat, lines 247-259; Section 10) routes to as the residual. The proposed conv fix touches fused_tree_conv_taps_acc + triton_ex2_silu_bf16 (downstream of the snapshot, per-element, no cross-row reduction) — it cannot alter the scan state-feed realization that compounds the deficit. So even a PERFECT conv->0.0 leaves the diffuse scan-state carrier intact, and the e2e flips would NOT drop to ~3. This is the same complete-non-response signature as QPAD, but the root is upstream-adjacent-yet-different-op (scan state-feed), not downstream (FA2).

NET: the fix is correctly localized and policy-compliant, and conv IS the L0 first-nonzero (so it earns being aligned as ONE necessary front), but it is NOT the dominant carrier of the 22 flips — that is the GDN recurrent scan state-feed. The design doc is honest about this (Section 6/7c/10 explicitly predict a residual and route to tree-reshape). wouldFixReduceFlips=false as a standalone lever.
verify.alternativeOps: conv1d is the L0 first-nonzero ENTRY sub-op but NOT the flip carrier. The next/actual candidate carriers, ranked by live evidence: (1) GDN recurrent SCAN STATE-FEED (h0_state_in / gdn_scan_out) = the dominant carrier per the two most-recent dual-verified binds. FR13_GATEA:204 shows it as the live L8 first-divergence (h0_state_in 0.0007) AFTER the conv replica succeeded; FR13_NODE5_LADDER_DIFFUSE_BIND.md:53-61 pins it as the live rank-1 tree-scan over the accepted chain vs clean chunked-prefill scan — the documented chunk-vs-recurrent ~ULP realization gap, born at L0, amplified ~32x by gate 1/rms + deep full-attn, crystallizing at L60/L61. This is NOT a wrong-column read (fill/read land on the same column num_accepted-1, fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:624-706/439-448) — it is an intentionally-higher-precision (fp32 multi-column) realization of native's bf16 single-slot roll (mamba_utils.py:259-275), so it is a realization diff not a wiring bug. (2) The DIFFUSE per-layer GDN realization across all ~48 GDN layers (gate 1/rms amplification) — FR13_DIFFUSE_GDN_EXPLAINED.md, the splice@L58 reverts / splice@L0 still-flips substitution result = present at every GDN layer, adds up. Note: scan OP is M-invariant/BV-bit-exact in the SHALLOW single-forward regime (BV A/B D16=D32=0.0); the carrier is the state-feed in the DEEP-accept recurrent regime (num_accepted>=3), a regime the BV A/B did not cover. So the alternative is not 'a different M-tile' but 'a different op in a different regime' — the recurrent state-feed, addressed by tree-reshape (shallower + root-sibling = fewer co-resident deep nodes = less state-feed drift), not a per-op patch.
verify.recommendation: Land the conv ex2/MAC alignment as ONE necessary front (it IS the L0 first-nonzero and has a concrete bit-exact patch + is policy-compliant), gated by the offline multi-clean-layer conv1d_out==RAW-0.0 across L0,L4,L8,L12,L24,L36,L44 — but do NOT expect it to move the e2e flips alone, and do NOT close on per-layer 0.0. Reconcile with the concurrent GPU sub-op A/B by reading its M10-vs-M5 deep-row first-nonzero: if the A/B confirms conv1d_out as first-nonzero (matching NODE7-LADDER), proceed to align conv THEN immediately re-measure the SAME-input deep-row ladder past conv — the prediction (from FR13_GATEA:204 + NODE5_LADDER) is the residual carrier surfaces at h0_state_in/gdn_scan_out (the recurrent scan state-feed). The decisive instrument is the e2e per-token argmax-vs-clean flip count vs E5 (cat9 22 -> ?), NOT per-layer 0.0 (per reference_scalar_metric_per_token_blindspot). If conv->0.0 leaves flips ~22 (the predicted outcome), the lever is tree-reshape (project_fr13_tree_reshape_unifying_lever: shallower + root-sibling cuts co-resident deep-node state-feed drift) on the recurrent state-feed, NOT another per-op conv patch. Pin BI on both A/B arms (cat9+BI=34 is WORSE, so BI is not the fix). Bring the e2e flip pass/fail to the user; no close.
verify.issues:
1. STALE HEAD pointer: the committed FR13_CONV_FIX_DESIGN.md (HEAD b6c30b4b) header says 'HEAD 8b7684dd' but the notes field of the Read claims 'HEAD b6c30b4b' — minor, the design-doc commit IS b6c30b4b which parents 8b7684dd, so both are internally consistent; not a factual error.
2. The fix is presented as novel but is LARGELY ALREADY LANDED: the ex2 silu replica + bf16-tap arm are the CURRENT live path (triton_ex2_silu_bf16 uses tl.exp lowering to ex2.approx; fused_tree_conv_taps_acc rounds the bf16 product then fp32-accumulates ascending = the FR11-overturning bf16-taps arm that native empirically matches, FR13_GATEA:79-80,204). The genuinely-remaining conv delta is at most a sub-ULP op-order detail (native causal_conv1d.py:1044 keeps the bf16*bf16 product as fp32 in-accumulate; ours rounds product to bf16 first, line 234 — a REAL but tiny op-order seam). The design doc should state more plainly that the conv level was already driven to 0.0 at L0/L8 (GATEA:204 'grind SUCCEEDED') so this fix is a re-confirmation/cleanup of an existing front, not the flip lever.
3. EVIDENCE TENSION (the doc names it but under-weights it): the task premise 'conv1d is PRIME SUSPECT / carrier' is in direct tension with the two most-recent dual-verified binds (NODE5_LADDER 2026-06-14 holds=TRUE, DIFFUSE_GDN_EXPLAINED) which conclude the carrier is the diffuse recurrent state-feed with 'no single-seam fix.' The Read's notes field acknowledges this and reconciles it correctly (conv = first-nonzero entry, state-feed = growth/carrier), and the design doc Section 6/7c/10 are honest about it — so this is a framing risk, not a factual defect. holds=true because every cited mechanism line is exact and re-verified, and the fix is concrete + policy-compliant; but the answer to 'is conv the carrier' is NO (it's the entry point, the scan state-feed is the carrier).
4. The mechanism's claim that conv is 'row-occupancy M-invariant by construction' (per-b Python loop, no cross-row reduction) is CORRECT and verified at fr10_phase4...:2566-2598 + fused_tree_conv_taps_acc:234-248 — the only M-coupling is num_accepted-driven bank/column selection (correct on HEAD, h0_state_in=0.0 proves the row is right) + the bf16-tap realization. No issue here; this is well-supported.
